risk_assessment.headline_verdict: CRITICAL FLOOD DISASTER CONFIRMED along River Brahmaputra in Kamrup Metropolitan district.
risk_assessment.chain_of_thought_reasoning:
1. METEOROLOGICAL ANALYSIS: Active cloudburst/extreme rainfall event (68.0 mm/h, 24h cumulative 210.0 mm) with sharp barometric depression (-7.5 hPa) and squall gusts (65.0 km/h).
2. HYDRAULIC & RIVERINE STAGE: River Brahmaputra has BREACHED the official Danger Level (50.50 m) at 51.200 m (buffer: +0.700 m). Rate of rise is surging at +0.000 m/h.
3. TOPOGRAPHIC RUNOFF BEHAVIOR: Catchment terrain has low permeability (Silty Clay Loam, runoff coefficient 0.78, TWI 12.2), accelerating overland surge directly into drainage networks (choke ratio: 88%).
4. SPACEBORNE OBSERVATION: Clear sky condition (20% cloud); optical NDWI (0.720) and SAR radar (-23.5 dB) corroborate surface water extent.
5. CROSS-DOMAIN SYNTHESIS: Multi-agent consensus weighted score evaluates to 0.950 with 94.5% sensor certainty. Conclusion: CRITICAL FLOOD DISASTER CONFIRMED along River Brahmaputra in Kamrup Metropolitan district.

decision_and_early_warning.public_broadcast_sms: [RED FLOOD DELUGE ALERT] River Brahmaputra has BREACHED DANGER LEVELS in Kamrup Metropolitan. Immediate mandatory evacuation ordered for: Bharalumukh Sluice Gate Basin & Outfall, Anil Nagar & Nabin Nagar Low-Lying Urban Wards, Pandu Port Embankment & Railway Siding. Move to designated higher ground shelters immediately! Call 112 / 1070 for rescue.

recommended_tactical_actions.action: Deploy 4 NDRF battalions & SDRF motorized rescue boats to Bharalumukh Sluice Gate Basin & Outfall, Anil Nagar & Nabin Nagar Low-Lying Urban Wards.
Full closure of Brahmaputra outfall sluice gates to prevent backflow into Kamrup Metropolitan municipal storm channels.
Activate all auxiliary heavy dewatering diesel pumps (5000 gpm); shut down inundated electrical transformers.
Enforce traffic diversions across arterial bridges and secure elevated evacuation corridors to district relief shelters.
Establish mobile medical clinics, potable water tankers, and dry ration distribution in designated cyclone/flood shelters.
